# Video Extend

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — extend or continue an existing video clip on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes to Google Veo 3-1's `extend-video` and `fast/extend-video` endpoints: pick the source video plus a prompt describing what should happen next, and the model produces a clip that continues the original with consistent motion, lighting, and subject identity. Use when a short Veo clip needs to be longer, or to chain a narrative shot-by-shot from a single seed clip. Distinct from the temporal-edit siblings: video-extend continues *time*; video-inpainting/video-outpainting edit *space*. Requires a RunComfy account, the RunComfy CLI (`npm i -g @runcomfy/cli`), and generation calls are billed against API credits — a paid service. Honest notes: the source docs use RunComfy's "Pro Pack" marketing voice and carry tracking links; the technical content (endpoints, schemas, examples) is real and documented. By @prime-skills, listed here with credit to its creator. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
